description.text: Scholarship Policy: According to the strategy cooperation agreement between SICAS and University of Jinan, the students who get admission in this major through SICAS only have to payCNY25,000/Year instead of CNY 35,000 /Year from the second year and the third year. The first year is not included. The scholarship will directly to reduce the tuition, not cash. Special Scholarship for SICAS International Students in University of Jinan (click to apply)

duration.text: The Master Program of Medicine at University of Jinan is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3.undergraduatel's certificate Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of undergraduate 5.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport with good health. Applicants should own bachelor degree in concerned subjects or above.
